title: Nexus Flow Dashboard
summary: A React/Vite frontend dashboard for a clinical trial management system. Its requirements documents mention 'SDV' only as clinical trial jargon for Source Data Verification, unrelated to the Synthetic Data Vault library.
evidence: tmp_reqs/Sponsor_requirements.txt: 'SDV progress' / '% of verified (SDV) data' refers to Source Data Verification
needs: Confirm no code-level use of the SDV synthetic-data library; evidence shows only clinical-trial terminology collision.
